newsitem.title: UK: Britain's ITC clears Channel 5 for March 30 launch.
newsitem.headline: Britain's ITC clears Channel 5 for March 30 launch.

text.p: Britain's Independent Television Commission said on Thursday it had cleared the launch of the country's fifth television channel, Channel V, on March 30.
ITC said it was satisfied that at least 90 percent of television-owning British homes within the relevant transmission areas had had their TV and video equipment retuned.
